card.name: Nouns after 'the' in descriptive phrases
card.fires_on: Nouns and linking words inside 'the X of Y' descriptions in general web prose, such as 'the shape of an', 'the pockets of', 'the heart of'. It appears mostly in non-drug text.

modes.label: Shape and part nouns
modes.description: The noun right after 'the' that is followed by 'of', such as shape, pockets or heart.
modes.example: The EEJI has roughly the<< shape>> of an inverted triangle 90 km

modes.label: Words after the noun
modes.description: The 'of' or 'an' that follows such a noun and leads into a description.
modes.example: The EEJI has roughly the shape<< of>> an inverted triangle 90 km wide

card.plain: It marks a descriptive phrase like 'the shape of' or 'the pockets of' in ordinary prose, not label text.
